howToUpdate: Fortnite replay tags name weapons by internal codename (e.g. Weapon.Ranged.Pistol.Slingshot.HarmlessThrift), not by the name players see. Each entry lists codename pieces to look for in the tag after 'Weapon.Ranged.'; matching ignores case, dots and underscores, and the longest match wins. When Meter Checker shows only a class name like 'Pistol', hover the weapon to see its tag, add an entry here, and release a new version. Ammo 'Heavy' or sniper=true makes a final kill count as an automatic trickshot. Snipers without a scope (Hunting Rifle) set "scope": false so aimed shots show as 'Aimed (iron sights)'. Players can also name unknown weapons in Meter Checker; those are saved to %LOCALAPPDATA%\\Decrypts ClipShot\\weapons.json and checked first.
